title: CNN Case Study: ResNet Channel Pruning
analysis: Halving stage width reduced parameters from 20,650 to 5,466 and analytical work by 73.9%. Batch-1 medians were 0.121744 versus 0.095600 ms; batch-64 measured a 1.007x ratio. Random weights make this a systems/shape case study, not a Top-1 result.
conclusion: ResNet channel pruning is a stage-level graph transformation whose benefit must be measured at each target workload.
